meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: Claude 能用 DeepSpot-M 把 224x224 的 H&E 组织切片图块转换成虚拟空间转录组数据，输出每个基因在每个图块的表达量（log1p-CPM），并支持按基因符号查询约 19k 个蛋白质编码基因。
howto.when: 当你需要从 H&E 组织切片预测空间基因表达、按基因符号查询约 19k 个蛋白质编码基因，或想用 histolab 切片后对整张切片做批量预测时触发。

say.text: 用这个 H&E 图块预测 EPCAM 和 CD3D 的表达量。
say.note: 会调用 DeepSpot-M 输出 log1p-CPM 值。

say.text: 用 histolab 把这张切片切成图块，预测全切片转录组。
say.note: 会走切片加批量推理流程。

say.text: 查询 TP53 在这个图块中的表达量。
say.note: 基因需在约 19k 基因面板内，否则报错。

howto.what_en: DeepSpot-M maps a 224x224 H&E histology tile to virtual spatial transcriptomics in log1p-CPM: one value per queried gene per tile, covering ~19k protein-coding genes queried by symbol.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need spatial gene expression from H&E tiles, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol beyond a fixed panel, or want whole-slide prediction after tiling with histolab.

say_en.text: Predict expression of EPCAM and CD3D from this H&E tile.
say_en.note: Calls DeepSpot-M and returns log1p-CPM values.

say_en.text: Tile this slide with histolab, then predict the whole-slide transcriptome.
Query TP53 expression in this tile.
say_en.note: Gene must be in the ~19k panel or it errors.
